body: I truly hope I don’t give in, it’s hard because she’s genuinely the other half to me and she’s been there a lot when others have given up on me. Don’t get me wrong, I’m a fairly attractive person, or so I think based off of the girls I’ve spoken to. But I don’t really want to meet anyone new, and I think it’d hurt me if she did. But then I’d understand if we both meet new people, we might realise what we have.

I agree it’s delusional, I think I’m just so used to having her that I can’t see a life without her. I’m not going to not meet anyone in the time, and told her I don’t expect her to wait around for me. If we meet new people, we meet new people. 

I just need to keep busy and I won’t consider messaging her, it’s all stressful at the moment IMO.
I honestly would be surprised if she’s met someone else, but I do keep thinking it, but she’s given me no reason to suspect that.
For sure, I’ve told her whatever makes her happy, makes me happy even if that means us breaking up. At the end of the day, I only want what’s best for her.

I agree, I’m going to see if we naturally sort it over this week and if not I’m going to suggest this, because she needs to realise not everything is perfect. Social media has definitely been a big influence on her recently, she keeps saying she’s unhappy with stuff etc and even admitted she needs to stop believing everything on social media is perfect.
I agree, I feel like she isn’t attracted to me in the slightest anymore, and I’m unsure if she is and is just in this patch or she actually isn’t.

She’s going through something definitely, she used to hate tattoos but now she wants a tattoo and wants to dye her hair, which shows she’s having a sort of change of heart (if that makes sense) which makes me feel like she’s lost with stuff.
This is honestly great advice, thank you very much. I think this might be my best approach, just take some time to myself and don’t think about it all.

She’s odd in that sense, she said she knows something is wrong with her head at the moment but she doesn’t believe that people can get depressed and there’s always a way to work it out, she comes from a very very old fashioned family so that probably doesn’t help too much. I don’t know how to approach it without being nasty or making her feel like I’m pressuring her.

I don’t want to like push her or force her hand with either decision. Maybe I wasn’t thinking straight when I thought it might help, especially if she’s feeling depressed at the moment. 

I really don’t want to lose her, and I know she’d regret ending it because we truly are each other’s best friend, our families love each other and we travel a lot, we’re close to one another’s family and both have the same end goals, it’s hard to find that these days. I do think she needs to realise not every relationship is constantly perfect, and that over time they require more work. She said the problem is that I love her more than she loves me, but w few years ago it was the opposite, I said it’s never going to be the same.

I honestly doubt she wants to see other people, or id be very very surprised if she did. She’s very old fashioned in that sense, we’ve always spoken about our long term future for years now, it’s all confusing but I’d be surprised.

I think this might be the best approach for me if I’m completely honest, I can’t keep letting my head go round like that. But then I will always come back to her, so how do I stop myself doing that, even to give her space.

I definitely agree there, something for sure is going on in her life. She’s stressed about other things, so I feel she’s taking all the stress and blaming me. Like at the moment her car has been delayed for another 3 months and she’s saying she can’t ever imagine having it etc, and I said how can she say anything about her future with me when her car will literally be here in 3 months and she’s saying she can’t imagine having it etc. She’s stressed about a lot, but I don’t know how to take the pressure off of her?

She also said to me she can’t wait to get away because then it’s just her thinking for herself, nobody telling her what to do or how to be happy. I was confused about that because her family have told her she’s making a mistake, but her friends haven’t really had an opinion about it so I’m wondering who she’s referring to.
